(1)-(4), lines 125-132: H = -t0 sum (c+c + h.c.) + ω0 sum b+b + γ sum n_j (b+_j + b_j), spinless, coupling to n_j, no zero-point term; t0 = 1 unit of energy (line 148), ω0/t0 = 1, γ/t0 = 2 (lines 149-153), open boundary conditions (line 142), N = (L-1)/2, 'nearly half filling' (Fig. 16 caption): density 1/2 in the limit.
